Meta.title: Gymna — Your personal gym coach
Meta.description: A training plan built around your body, goals and health, with guided workouts and a coach you can message any time.

Common.errorBody: We couldn't load this page. Check your connection and try again.
Common.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist or has moved.

Landing.heroSubtitle: Tell Gymna about your body, your goal and any injuries. Get a weekly plan made for you, a demo for every exercise, and a coach who answers in seconds.
Landing.heroNote: Free to start. Takes about 3 minutes.

preview.coachMessage: Elbows at about 45°, not flared. Lower for two counts, then press.
preview.userMessage: My shoulders hurt on bench. Am I doing it wrong?

Landing.featuresSubtitle: Without the guesswork, and without waiting for your next session.

plan.title: A plan that fits you
plan.body: Your split, exercises, sets and rest come from your goal, level, schedule and equipment. Not a template.

safety.title: Works around injuries
safety.body: A short health check removes risky movements and swaps in safer ones for your back, knees or shoulders.

demos.title: A demo for every move
demos.body: See the movement, the muscles it trains, step-by-step cues and the mistakes to avoid.

session.title: Guided workout mode
session.body: One exercise at a time, big buttons, a set tracker and a rest timer that buzzes when it's time.

coach.title: A coach on chat
coach.body: Ask about form, soreness or what to eat after training. Answers know your plan and your health notes.

progress.title: Progress you can see
progress.body: Streaks, badges, training volume and body-weight charts keep you honest and motivated.

Landing.howTitle: From sign-up to first set in minutes

one.title: Tell us about you
one.body: Age, height, weight, goal, experience, training days and equipment.

two.title: Quick health check
two.body: A few yes or no questions so your plan respects your body.

three.title: Train with your plan
three.body: Open today's workout, follow the demos, log your sets and watch the numbers climb.

Landing.coachTitle: Feels like texting a real coach
Landing.coachBody: Describe how a lift felt and get clear corrections. Ask in Arabic or English. The coach stays on fitness and tells you to see a doctor when something needs one.

coachPoints.one: Knows your plan, level and injuries
coachPoints.three: Safe by design: no diagnoses, no crash diets

Landing.finalBody: Build your plan now and train today.

Footer.disclaimer: Gymna gives general fitness guidance. It does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or certified trainer. Check with a doctor before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have a health condition or injury. Stop and seek medical help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.

about.title: Let's start with you
about.subtitle: These numbers size your plan. They stay private.

bmi.title: Your BMI
bmi.empty: Enter your height and weight to see your BMI.
bmi.note: BMI is a rough guide. It can't tell muscle from fat.
bmi.scaleLabel: BMI {value} on a scale from 15 to 40

goal.title: What's your main goal?
goal.subtitle: It sets your reps, rest and exercise mix.

FAT_LOSS.title: Lose fat
FAT_LOSS.body: Higher reps, shorter rest, more work per session.

MUSCLE_GAIN.title: Build muscle
MUSCLE_GAIN.body: Moderate reps with enough volume to grow.

STRENGTH.title: Get stronger
STRENGTH.body: Heavier sets, lower reps, longer rest.

GENERAL_FITNESS.title: General fitness
GENERAL_FITNESS.body: A balanced mix to feel and move better.

level.title: How experienced are you?
level.subtitle: Be honest. Starting at the right level is how you progress fastest.

BEGINNER.title: Beginner
BEGINNER.body: New to training, or less than 6 months of it.

INTERMEDIATE.title: Intermediate
INTERMEDIATE.body: Training regularly for 6 months to 2 years.

ADVANCED.title: Advanced
ADVANCED.body: More than 2 years of consistent training.

schedule.title: When and where do you train?
schedule.subtitle: Pick what you can keep up every week.

DUMBBELLS.title: Home with dumbbells
DUMBBELLS.body: Dumbbells, with or without a bench.

schedule.whichDaysHint: Pick {count} days. Leave rest days between hard sessions when you can.

health.title: A quick health check
health.subtitle: Answer honestly. A yes doesn't stop you training; it makes your plan safer.

questions.heartCondition: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition?
questions.chestPain: Do you get chest pain during activity or at rest?
questions.highBloodPressure: Do you have high blood pressure?
questions.dizziness: Do you lose balance from dizziness, or ever lose consciousness?
questions.lowerBack: Do you have a lower back injury or ongoing back pain?
questions.knee: Do you have a knee injury or ongoing knee pain?
questions.shoulder: Do you have a shoulder injury or ongoing shoulder pain?
questions.otherJoint: Any other joint problem (wrist, elbow, hip, ankle)?
questions.recentSurgery: Have you had surgery in the last 12 months?
questions.pregnancy: Are you pregnant, or did you give birth in the last 6 months?

health.notesPlaceholder: For example: old ankle sprain, asthma, medication…
health.noticeTitle: Please check with a doctor first
health.noticeBody: Based on your answers, get medical clearance before you start training. You can still build your plan now. We'll keep it conservative and leave out movements that could aggravate what you told us.
health.disclaimerLabel: I understand that Gymna gives general fitness guidance and does not replace a doctor or a certified trainer.

Today.missedBody: Today is a rest day, so there's room to make it up and keep your week on track.

restTips.0: Muscles grow while you rest. Eat well and get your sleep tonight.
restTips.1: A walk or some light stretching today will help you recover faster.
restTips.2: Drink water through the day. Recovery starts there.
restTips.3: Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it. Enjoy it.
restTips.4: Aim for 7 to 9 hours of sleep. That's where the strength gets built.

Today.doneBody: Good work. Eat, rest and come back ready.
Today.questionsBody: There are a few new questions about your experience and the weights you lift now.

Plan.cautious: Built on the careful side because of your health answers.

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.
errors.server_error: We couldn't build the plan. Try again in a moment.

start_baseline.0: Based on the lift you told me. Today is a test run, so tell me how the first set feels.
start_baseline.1: Starting from your own numbers. The first set tells us if it's right.
start_baseline.2: This comes from what you already lift. We fine-tune after set one.

start_related.0: Estimated from your other lifts. Tell me how the first set feels and I'll adjust.
start_related.1: A starting guess from your main lifts. We correct it after the first set.
start_related.2: Worked out from the lifts you know. The first set is the check.

start_bodyweight.0: A light start for your first time. Tell me how it feels and I'll adjust.
start_bodyweight.1: Starting easy on purpose. Form first, then we add weight.
start_bodyweight.2: First time here, so we begin light and find your level.

step_up.0: You hit every rep last time. Up from {from} to {to}.
step_up.1: Top of the range on all sets. Time to move from {from} to {to}.
step_up.2: Last session was clean. Adding weight: {to}.

step_up_easy.0: Last time felt easy, so a bigger jump: {from} to {to}.
step_up_easy.1: You had plenty left last time. Going up to {to}.
step_up_easy.2: Too easy last session. Let's make it count: {to}.

hold_confirm.0: Good session last time. One more like it at this weight, then we go up.
hold_confirm.1: Same weight once more. Nail it again and you've earned the next step.
hold_confirm.2: We go up carefully: repeat last session's quality first.

add_reps.0: Same weight. Aim for {target} on every set.
add_reps.1: Stay here and chase reps: {target} per set.
add_reps.2: Weight stays. Get to {target} per set, then we add more.

hold_missed.0: A few reps short last time. Same weight, take it back.
hold_missed.1: Last session fell under the range. Stay here and own it today.
hold_missed.2: No rush. Same weight until the reps are there.

hold_hard.0: Last time was a grind. Same weight until it feels solid.
hold_hard.1: That was heavy last session. Hold here today.
hold_hard.2: Staying put. Smooth reps before more weight.

reduce.0: Two tough sessions in a row. Dropping from {from} to {to} to rebuild.
reduce.1: Stepping back to {to}. Clean reps now, heavier soon.
reduce.2: This weight has been fighting you. {to} today, then back up.

deload.0: You've been stuck here a while. A lighter day at {to}, then we push again.
deload.1: Time for a reset. {to} today to come back stronger.
deload.2: Progress stalled, so we back off to {to} and build again.

new_range.0: Your plan changed the reps, so the weight changes too: {to}.

bodyweight_start.0: Just your body weight. Clean, controlled reps.
bodyweight_start.1: No weight needed. Focus on the full range.
bodyweight_start.2: Body weight only. Make every rep look the same.

bodyweight_reps.0: Beat last time: aim for {target} per set.
bodyweight_reps.1: One more than last session. Go for {target}.
bodyweight_reps.2: Chase the reps here: {target} on each set.

bodyweight_harder.0: You maxed this out. Slow it down or swap to a harder variation.
bodyweight_harder.1: Top of the range on every set. You're ready for a harder version.
bodyweight_harder.2: This one is getting easy. Try a tougher variation from the swap menu.

Workout.cautious: Take it steady today. Stop any exercise that causes pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.
Workout.calibrationQuestion: How did that first set feel?

adjusted.set_easy: Easy one. Next sets go up to {weight}.
adjusted.set_hard: Let's ease off. Next sets at {weight}.
adjusted.set_missed: Dropping to {weight} so you hit the reps.

Workout.allDone: That's every exercise. Hit Finish when you're ready.

Finish.title: Workout done!
Finish.subtitle: {day} is in the books.
Finish.streak: {count, plural, one {# workout in a row} other {# workouts in a row}}

upper.0: Stretch your chest and shoulders for a minute each, then get some protein in within the next couple of hours.
upper.1: Hang from a bar or stretch your lats for 30 seconds, roll your shoulders out, and drink some water.
upper.2: Shake your arms out and stretch your triceps and chest. Your upper body earned a good meal.

lower.0: Walk for five minutes before you sit down, then stretch your quads and hamstrings. Your legs will thank you tomorrow.
lower.1: Stretch your hips and calves for a minute each. Expect some soreness in a day or two, that's normal.
lower.2: Easy walk, a long drink of water, and a hamstring stretch. Leg days need the most recovery, so sleep well tonight.

full.0: Five easy minutes of walking, then stretch whatever feels tightest. Eat well and sleep well.
full.1: You worked everything today. Drink water, have a proper meal, and take tomorrow lighter.
full.2: Stretch your hips, chest and back for a minute each. Whole-body days need a whole night's sleep.

cautious.0: Sit for a couple of minutes and let your breathing settle before you leave. If anything felt off today, mention it to your doctor.
cautious.1: Cool down with a slow five-minute walk and some water. Sharp pain, dizziness or chest discomfort is a reason to stop and get checked.
cautious.2: Nice and steady today. Stretch gently, don't push into pain, and note how you feel tomorrow.

Progress.title: Your progress
Progress.chartOnePoint: One workout so far. The line starts with your next one.
Progress.emptyBody: Finish your first workout and your lifts, records and charts will show up here.
